exact: regulation of cytoskeleton polarization involved in growth plate cartilage chondrocyte division by planar cell polarity pathway

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by binding of a Wnt protein to a receptor on the surface of the target cell that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of the polarization of cytoskeletal structures in a growth plate cartilage chondrocyte. This process results in the oriented division of the cell.
label: regulation of cytoskeleton polarization involved in growth plate cartilage chondrocyte division
